title: Android CheckedTextView: custom mark tint modes
purpose: Compare Android XML checkMarkTintMode values on the same custom check-mark shape.
changes: Added six explicit tint modes for supported custom CheckedTextView mark shapes.
steps: Find Custom check-mark tint modes below the RTL switch. Each row names a tint mode and shows the same amber shape tinted with translucent blue.
Compare the shapes: src_in is translucent blue, src_atop mixes blue and amber, and multiply appears dark. The other modes also have their own colors.
Tap the rows and turn on Right-to-left layout. The shapes move to the left and retain their colors.
Choose OK if the page looks and behaves correctly, or Reject with the failing row and your device.
expected: Each tint mode composes the same mark and tint independently; row interaction and RTL mark placement continue to work.
limits: Explicit modes apply only to supported custom solid shapes. Built-in check-mark tint modes, other drawable types, edge compositing and Android device pixel parity remain open.

references.scope: Check-mark drawable tint mode and state.

validation: 150 Android XML importer tests passed, including all six modes and invalid inputs.
Three focused CheckedTextView custom mark rendering tests passed, including src_atop composition.
